intro: Help Victor Graves break free from a warlock’s control and save the Academy of Magic through classic mahjong puzzles
description:
An insidious warlock has seized control of Victor Graves’ body, manipulating his voice, his actions, and his reputation to infiltrate the Academy’s inner circle. Under the guise of a trusted mentor, the warlock weaves a sinister plan: to bind the next generation of mages into eternal loyalty and raise an unstoppable magical army. Powerless yet conscious, Victor is trapped inside, fighting to reclaim his own mind.

Through classic mahjong gameplay combined with engaging hidden object challenges, players must uncover clues, break enchantments, and weaken the warlock’s hold from within. Each level brings you closer to restoring Victor’s control and exposing the deception threatening the Academy.

With richly detailed environments, immersive magical themes, and a hauntingly beautiful soundtrack, “Mahjongus 2: The Warlock Within” delivers a thrilling continuation of the series—where every move matters, and the greatest battle is for the soul itself.

● 150 Mahjong levels to play!
● 14 extra HOGs!
● Classic Mahjong Gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and immersive music!
● Fascinating story full of twists!
● Dive into a world of magic and intrigue!
● Explore vibrant, mystical environments!
● Save Victor Graves and the Academy from a dark warlock!
